title: Negative control: unstabilized P1/P1 is not inf-sup stable (must fail visibly); Taylor-Hood stable
physics: discrete inf-sup constants of P2/P1 and P1/P1 on the unit square; TH mesh-corner check

structured.construction: f1a_stokes_check.structured_mesh(N): the N = 8 BASE mesh (8 x 8 squares split along the (1,1) diagonal, except the two cells at the corners (1,0) and (0,1), split the other way: no triangle with all vertices on the boundary) refined uniformly (red) log2(N/8) times. Nested; the flipped region of level N is a (N/8) x (N/8) block at each of those corners. The check module verifies counts, hash and nestedness.
structured.h_definition: h_nominal = 1/N (leg of the right triangles); h_max = sqrt(2)/N reported too

meshes.bad_corner: structured N = 16 with ALL cells split by the (1,1) diagonal: the cells at the corners (1,0) and (0,1) contain a triangle with all three vertices on the boundary

parameters.inf_sup: f1a_stokes_check.inf_sup: eigenvalues lambda of B A^-1 B^T q = lambda M_p q, A the vector H1-seminorm Gram matrix on the free (non-Dirichlet) velocity DOFs, M_p the pressure mass matrix (dense, N <= 32). lambda <= 1e-10 lambda_max counts as a ZERO MODE (the constant is one); beta_h = sqrt(smallest lambda above that threshold).
parameters.mms_informative: sq_dirichlet with P1/P1 unstabilized: errors reported in notes, not judged
